newsitem.title: TURKMENISTAN: Turkmen cotton harvest lags at 39,464 T on Sept 11.
newsitem.headline: Turkmen cotton harvest lags at 39,464 T on Sept 11.

text.p: Turkmenistan had harvested 39,464 tonnes of raw cotton as of September 11, only 2.82 percent of the planned target of 1.4 million tonnes, the Central Asian state's agriculture ministry said.
By the same time last year, the harvest had reached 130,324 tonnes, or 9.65 percent of the planned total.
Turkmenistan's 1995 raw cotton harvest totalled 1.305 million tonnes, below a 1.350 million target but higher than the previous year's 1.280 million output.

Agriculture ministry officials said the cotton harvest started late this year and the crop had been hit by frost and insects. Part of the crop had to be resown, they said, without giving any further details.
